title: Valid Parentheses
description: You are given a string made only of the characters ( ) [ ] { }. Decide whether it is valid. A string is valid when every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket, and brackets are closed in the correct order.
constraints:
1 <= length of s <= 10^4
s contains only the characters ()[]{}
inputFormat: A single line containing the string s.
outputFormat: Print true if s is valid, otherwise print false.
hints: The most recently opened bracket has to be the first one closed.
A stack follows exactly that order.
At the end, the stack must be empty for the string to be valid.

examples.explanation: Each pair is opened and closed in order.
The bracket types do not match.
